dataclass Alias
  host: str
  name: str
  resident: bool
  servable: bool
  hosted: bool
  profiles: list[str]
  held_in: list[str]
  context_length: int
  effective_context_length: int
dataclass Ask
  at: str
  caller: str
  user: str
  model: str
  family: str
  verdict: str
  host: str
enum AvailabilityCause
  TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE = 'transport_unavailable'
  CREDENTIAL = 'credential'
  RIGHTS = 'rights'
  CONFIGURATION = 'configuration'
  MALFORMED = 'malformed'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  OTHER = 'other'
const CREDENTIAL_CONSUMERS
dataclass Caller
  user_description: str
  path_description: str
dataclass Component
  store: str
  role: str
  name: str
enum ContextSource
  EFFECTIVE = 'effective'
  MAXIMUM = 'maximum'
  DEFAULT = 'default'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  NONE = 'none'
dataclass Decision
  asked: str

  verdict: str

  model: str
  endpoint: str
  installed_on: list[str]
  authorised: HostAllowance | None
  withheld: list[str]
  loads: int
  why: str
class DispatchError(ValueError)
  __init__(code)
dataclass Family
  family: str
  names: list[Alias]
  held_in: list[str]
  family_source: str

dataclass HostAllowance
  hosts: list[str]
dataclass HostState

  hosted: bool

dataclass HostsSnapshot

  doubled: list[str]

dataclass ModelsSnapshot

  input: int

enum OfferOutcome
  OFFERED = 'offered'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  NOT_PERMITTED = 'not_permitted'
dataclass OfferRequest
  profile: str

  reserve: int
  fresh: bool

const PROFILES
dataclass PickRequest
  model: str
  fresh: bool

  profile: str
dataclass PickResult
  observation: Observation
  decision: Decision
enum Placement
  LOCAL = 'local'
  HOSTED = 'hosted'
  ANY = 'any'
const ROUTER_ERROR_CODES
class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
class Router
  models(fresh: bool) -> ModelsSnapshot
  hosts(fresh: bool) -> HostsSnapshot
  pick(request: PickRequest) -> PickResult
  offer(request: OfferRequest) -> OfferSnapshot
class RouterClient(Router)
  __init__(transport)
  models(fresh: bool) -> ModelsSnapshot
  hosts(fresh: bool) -> HostsSnapshot
  pick(request: PickRequest) -> PickResult
  offer(request: OfferRequest) -> OfferSnapshot

  __init__(code, message)
